_readme: Overrides merged into the extracted EPTTS API test cases by scripts/eptts-api-testcases.js.
The source spreadsheet (EPTTS - API TEST CASES.xlsx) contains 348 rows, of which 24 are
incomplete: TC_SHIP_025..044 are entirely empty reserved ID slots (only an ID and
Validity=Negative), TC_AUTH_013 has a title but no Steps/Expected Results, and
TC_COMM_040..042 have Steps but no Expected Results.
Rather than emit malformed rows or silently drop the IDs (which would break the 1:1 mapping
back to the spreadsheet), the missing fields are authored here in the source's own house
style. Only keys present in an override replace the extracted value; everything else still
comes from the sheet. `_authored` records why, and the extractor lists every overridden ID in
its summary so authored content is never mistaken for extracted content.
GLNs: newly authored cases use the devsim tenant's manufacturer GLN (8435308300002). Cases
extracted from the sheet still carry the old staging GLNs (5413868000009 etc.) and must be
re-mapped once Phase 2 recon confirms the devsim branch/pharmacy GLNs.
_additions (added 2026-09-07) is a SEPARATE mechanism from the overrides above. An override
fills fields on an ID the sheet already has; an addition introduces an ID the sheet never
had. It exists because the platform implements three dispense-reversal operations the sheet
has no row for - Dispensing Cancellation, Partial Dispensing Cancellation and Patient
Return - each confirmed live against the relay on 2026-09-07 by submitting ten action and
bizStep combinations and reading which ones a handler answered. Keyed by sheet name.

TC_AUTH_013._authored: Source has a title but empty Steps and Expected Results.
steps: Log into the dashboard and change the account password via Account settings
Send an authentication request with a valid API key using the OLD password
Post request
expected: The response is HTTP 401 Unauthorized
No access token is returned
The old credentials are rejected for every subsequent request

TC_COMM_040._authored: Source has Steps but empty Expected Results. Recorded Status=Pass, i.e. the platform correctly rejects a foreign sender identifier.
expected: The request is rejected because the SBDH sender identifier must match the authenticated manufacturer's GLN
No pack is commissioned
The SGTIN remains non-existent in the system

TC_COMM_041._authored: Source has Steps but empty Expected Results. Recorded Status=Fail — the platform currently ACCEPTS a foreign readPoint. Expected Results state the correct behaviour, so the case legitimately fails until fixed.
expected: The request is rejected because readPoint must reference an SGLN belonging to the authenticated manufacturer's GLN
No pack is commissioned

TC_COMM_042._authored: Source has Steps but empty Expected Results. Recorded Status=Fail — the platform currently ACCEPTS a foreign bizLocation. Expected Results state the correct behaviour, so the case legitimately fails until fixed.
expected: The request is rejected because bizLocation must reference an SGLN belonging to the authenticated manufacturer's GLN
No pack is commissioned

TC_SHIP_025._authored: Empty reserved slot. Continues the mandatory-field sequence begun at TC_SHIP_020.
TC_SHIP_025.title: Verify shipping with an empty event time.
pre: There is an existing sealed SSCC to ship
steps: Post a Shipping (Object) event request with an empty eventTime field
Observe the synchronous API response
expected: The request is rejected synchronously with 400 Bad Request
The response body indicates eventTime is mandatory and cannot be empty
No event is queued and no MsgStatusQuery record is created

TC_SHIP_040._authored: Empty reserved slot. GLN-ownership negative — the platform's most important authorization rule.
TC_SHIP_040.title: Verify shipping an SSCC that is owned by a different GLN.
pre: The SSCC exists but is owned by a different trade partner GLN
steps: Post a Shipping (Object) event request referencing an SSCC owned by another GLN
Poll MsgStatusQuery with the instanceIdentifier
expected: The response is 202 Accepted
MsgStatusQuery eventually returns FAILED
The failure reason indicates the acting GLN does not own the referenced EPC
The SSCC remains under its original owner and its state is unchanged

TC_SHIP_041.title: Verify a Pharmacy role cannot post a manufacturer-to-branch shipping event.
pre: Authenticated as Pharmacy with a valid Pharmacy API key
There is an existing sealed SSCC owned by the manufacturer
data: Source GLN: 8435308300002 (the manufacturer, not the caller)
steps: Post a Shipping (Object) event request authenticated as Pharmacy but with the manufacturer as source GLN
Observe the API response and poll MsgStatusQuery if accepted
expected: The request is rejected with 403 Forbidden, or MsgStatusQuery returns FAILED
The failure reason indicates the authenticated role is not permitted to act for the given source GLN
The SSCC state is unchanged

TC_SHIP_042.title: Verify re-submitting a shipping event with an already-used instance identifier.
pre: A shipping event has already been submitted successfully with a known instanceIdentifier
data: instanceIdentifier: (reuse the identifier from the previous successful submission)
steps: Post a second Shipping (Object) event request reusing the previous instanceIdentifier
Poll MsgStatusQuery with that instanceIdentifier
Query the EPCIS message list for events sharing the identifier
expected: The duplicate submission is rejected, or is treated as idempotent and does not create a second event
MsgStatusQuery still reflects the original submission's outcome
The SSCC in the second request is not shipped (as per business rules)

TC_SHIP_043.title: Verify shipping with a Content-Type that does not match the request body.
pre: There is an existing sealed SSCC to ship
data: Body: a valid EPCIS 2.0 JSON shipping document
steps: Post a Shipping event request with Content-Type application/xml and a JSON body
Observe the synchronous API response
expected: The request is rejected with 400 Bad Request or 415 Unsupported Media Type
The response body indicates the payload could not be parsed as the declared content type
No event is queued and no MsgStatusQuery record is created

TC_SHIP_044.title: Verify shipping rejects injection payloads in the invoice number.
pre: There is an existing sealed SSCC to ship
steps: Post a Shipping event request with a SQL injection string as the invoice number
Observe the response
Repeat with an XSS payload as the invoice number
Query the EPCIS message list and the invoice listing
expected: Both requests are rejected by input validation, or the value is stored inert and never interpreted
No SQL error is returned and no database behaviour changes
The payload is escaped wherever it is rendered and no script executes
No unintended shipment is created

Dispensing._authored: Already implemented in the automated suite but never documented: the sheet stops at TC_DISP_033, so adding TC_DISP_035-037 left a numbering gap the case validator caught. It covers the single most likely reason a real dispensing integration fails - 27 of the manufacturer's 30 products are Dawana-integrated and must be dispensed through that channel instead.
Dispensing.title: Verify dispensing a Dawana-integrated product through this API is refused.
pre: Citrix VPN connected (or the ngrok relay reachable)
A pack of a Dawana-integrated product has been received by this pharmacy
data: GTIN: any product whose registry record has isDawanaIntegration true
epcList: [the SGTIN held by this pharmacy]
steps: Walk a pack of a Dawana-integrated product through to the pharmacy and confirm it is received
Post a full Dispensing (Object) event for that SGTIN
Poll MsgStatusQuery until the message reaches a terminal state
expected: The dispense is refused
The refusal names the Dawana channel: "Dispensing is not allowed for Dawana-integrated products via this channel. These products must be dispensed through the Dawana integration."
The pack is not dispensed and remains active in the pharmacy's stock

Dispensing._authored: No sheet row covers reversing a dispense, though the feature workflow lists Dispense Cancel as required coverage. Shape confirmed live 2026-09-07: action DELETE with bizStep dispensing is answered by the platform's own Dispensing Cancellation handler, and per the product owner this is how a patient return is recorded.
Dispensing.title: Verify a patient return is recorded as a Dispensing Cancellation and puts the pack back into pharmacy stock.
pre: Citrix VPN connected (or the ngrok relay reachable)
A pack of a non-Dawana, dispensable product has been received by this pharmacy
The pack has just been dispensed (status = Dispensed)
steps: Dispense the pack with a full Dispensing (Object) event and confirm its status becomes Dispensed
Post a Dispensing Cancellation (Object) event with action DELETE, bizStep dispensing and disposition active for the same SGTIN
Poll MsgStatusQuery until the message reaches a terminal state
Read the pack back with POST /VerifyProduct
expected: 202 Accepted on submission, then MsgStatusQuery reports S - Successful
The original dispensing event is cancelled
pack.status returns to active - the medicine is pharmacy stock again
pack.currentGln is unchanged and still the pharmacy: a return from a patient does not move custody between trade partners

Dispensing._authored: Companion to TC_DISP_035. bizStep patient_return also has a live handler (Patient Return event failed: ...), so what it does relative to Dispensing Cancellation needs pinning down rather than assuming the two are interchangeable.
Dispensing.title: Verify the platform routes a Patient Return event and record how its effect compares with a Dispensing Cancellation.
pre: Citrix VPN connected (or the ngrok relay reachable)
A pack of a non-Dawana, dispensable product has been received by this pharmacy
The pack has just been dispensed (status = Dispensed)
steps: Dispense the pack and confirm its status becomes Dispensed
Post an Object event with action OBSERVE, bizStep patient_return and disposition active for the same SGTIN
Poll MsgStatusQuery until the message reaches a terminal state
Read the pack back with POST /VerifyProduct
expected: The event is routed to the platform's Patient Return handler rather than being ignored
202 Accepted on submission, then MsgStatusQuery reaches a terminal state naming Patient Return
The resulting pack.status is recorded, so any divergence from TC_DISP_035 is visible rather than assumed

Dispensing._authored: Authored while establishing the reversal contract. Guards two things at once: that the platform refuses an action/bizStep pairing it cannot route (it does, with A - Technical Error / No valid events found in eventList), and that our own poller recognises the A status class — misreading A as pending produced a false bug report on 2026-09-07.
Dispensing.title: Verify an event whose action and business-step combination the platform does not support is refused rather than silently accepted.
pre: Citrix VPN connected (or the ngrok relay reachable)
A pack of a non-Dawana, dispensable product has been received by this pharmacy
data: bizStep: patient_return (an unsupported pairing; DELETE goes with dispensing, OBSERVE with patient_return)
epcList: [an SGTIN held by this pharmacy]
steps: Post an Object event pairing action DELETE with bizStep patient_return for a pack the pharmacy holds
Poll MsgStatusQuery for at least 90 seconds
expected: The document is refused, not silently accepted
MsgStatusQuery reports A - Technical Error with logList entry "No valid events found in eventList" on the first poll
The submission does not remain pending indefinitely
The pack is left untouched, still active in the pharmacy's stock

Partial Dispensing._authored: No sheet row covers reversing a partial dispense. Confirmed live 2026-09-07 that action DELETE with bizStep partial_dispensing is answered by the platform's own Partial Dispensing Cancellation handler, a third operation distinct from the full-pack cancellation.
Partial Dispensing.title: Verify cancelling a partial dispense returns the dispensed units to the pack.
pre: Citrix VPN connected (or the ngrok relay reachable)
A pack of a product registered with dispenseType partial has been received by this pharmacy
Part of the pack has been dispensed (status = Partially dispensed)
data: quantity: the number of units to return (required for a partial cancellation)
steps: Partially dispense a quantity from the pack and confirm the remaining quantity
Post a Partial Dispensing Cancellation (Object) event with action DELETE, bizStep partial_dispensing, disposition active and the quantity to return
Poll MsgStatusQuery until the message reaches a terminal state
Read the pack back with POST /VerifyProduct
expected: 202 Accepted on submission, then MsgStatusQuery reports S - Successful
The returned units are added back to the pack's remaining quantity
pack.currentGln is unchanged and still the pharmacy
